characters.name: Gladias
characters.voice_notes: Protagonist of the Veridia chapters. Thoughtful, calm, gentle, philosophical, with an occasional mischievous streak; a little awkward under pressure. Acolyte of the Order of Steering (accepted as a Keeper in ch. 8). Husband of Seila, father of Zven and Lily. Many of his lines are subvocalised whispers through a neck band.

characters.name: Seila
characters.age: adult (age not stated; Gladias's wife, roughly his age)
characters.voice_notes: Warm, upbeat, curious and encouraging; a blogger on economics and culture. Wife of Gladias, mother of Zven and Lily. Travels to Freetown and then Iptak.

characters.name: Zven
characters.voice_notes: Excitable, loud, playful and competitive; son of Gladias and Seila.

characters.name: Febric
characters.age: teen (older teenager, not quite an adult)
characters.voice_notes: Bright, enthusiastic, affectionate programming geek; son of Vil and Daia (the co-family); calls Gladias 'Uncle Glad'.

characters.name: Lily
characters.age: child or young teen (school age; exact age not given)
characters.voice_notes: Quiet, downcast, low self-confidence about school results; daughter of Gladias and Seila. Mumbling in ch. 1, sobbing in ch. 8.

characters.name: boy with drone
characters.voice_notes: One excited shout while playing a drone-catching game with his family.

characters.name: entrance gate machine
characters.voice_notes: Short synthetic confirmation voice from a credential-checking gate; robotic but approving. Ch. 1 is the concert gate, ch. 3 the Greater Plum Harbor gate; same type of voice.

characters.name: burly man at concert
characters.voice_notes: Large concertgoer who shouts over loud metal music to expose Gladias for the bounty and then films him; loud, rough yell.

characters.name: hand device
characters.voice_notes: The burly man's handheld device confirming a voice command; terse, flat synthetic readout.

characters.name: Anonymous
characters.voice_notes: Written text messages from an anonymous verified sender; calm, polite but faintly menacing. The sender is revealed in ch. 3 to be Delwart, so Delwart's voice (or a neutral message-readout voice) fits.

notes: No letter is shared by two speakers in this chapter, so there are no exceptions. 1:86 (P) has no named speaker in the text (an unidentified person behind Gladias); I assigned it to the burly man who is then found right behind Gladias filming him - likely but not explicit. 1:152 and 1:156 (A) are written messages from 'Anonymous'; the sender turns out to be Delwart (ch. 3), so Delwart's voice can be reused. 1:97 (D) is the burly man's hand device answering Gladias's voice command. 1:13 is a silent subvocalised command to Emerald; 1:96 is a spoken command to the stolen device. Sung/quoted text that sits in narrator runs: 1:60 and 1:70 are lyrics sung by Dreadknot's lead singer (gnarly metal voice); they are N runs and are not listed as narrator exceptions because the singer is not an N-named character.
